READ THE FINDINGS IN CONTEXT

Sources and methodology

Sources, image map & interpretation notes

Source of truth

31 CSV responses submitted 19 November 2026. The questionnaire PDF confirms the administered wording. “Survey - A_B Test .docx” supplies the image-to-question map. All six PNGs are supplied research stimuli, not redesigned emails.

Quote IDs follow CSV row order. Quotes preserve original spelling; whitespace may be normalised. Open-answer themes are manually coded and overlap.

Important limits

  • Small, US-only sample; stated preferences rather than actual opens or conversions.
  • A was listed first. The effect of presentation order is unknown.
  • Everyone reviewed the full email before isolated section ratings. Section scores do not isolate causal effects.
  • All topline percentages use 31 respondents; headline audience filters use the selected subgroup. Rounded percentages may not sum to 100.

Q3 sentiment is manually coded to user-authorised aggregate totals and the supplied A/B split. Coding IDs and notes ↗. Q7 categories and issue counts are manually coded. Priority tiers follow the number of respondents mentioning each issue, with ties at the same tier. Counts do not measure conversion impact.
